name: StuLife
description: StuLife is a benchmark designed to evaluate self-evolving agents through experience-driven lifelong learning by simulating a student's college journey across multiple phases and scenarios. It assesses agents' abilities in long-term memory retention, intrinsic motivation, and autonomous learning with novel metrics such as StuGPA.
reputation: A niche but increasingly cited benchmark in lifelong-learning and autonomous-agent research, though it is not yet a standard community leaderboard.
notes: Evaluates lifelong learning and self-motivated initiative; current SOTA (GPT-5) scores low.
